about_the_game:
This demo lets you play the opening section of Aeterna Lucis, focused on the mysterious Tower of Light, where you take control of the Queen of Light as she begins her journey after the events of Aeterna Noctis.

With a focus on fast-paced combat, metroidvania-style exploration, and powerful storytelling, this demo is your gateway into the next chapter of the Aeterna universe. Discover the saga’s signature art style, try out some of the new protagonist’s initial abilities, and immerse yourself in the epic tone that will define the full adventure.

What’s included in this demo:
· The beginning of the game: explore the Tower of Light, uncover secrets, face early challenges and enemies.
· Play as the Queen of Light: experience her unique combat style and early abilities.
· A glimpse of the hand-drawn art and music that define the game’s tone.
· Introductory dialogues and narrative that set the stage for the main story and conflict.

This demo is just a small part of the full experience. In the complete game, you’ll explore a vast interconnected world, unlock new areas, skills, weapons, and enemies, and face unimaginable challenges.

short_description: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
